podcast.body: Australian rockabilly performer Johnny O'Keefe wrote and recorded the original version of "Real Wild Child" in 1957, a song later covered by Iggy Pop. "The guy who wrote that song was an Australian rockabilly performer named Johnny O'Keefe. He recorded that song back in 1957."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About Iggy Pop
